observedMismatch: The normal user-facing Pokémon Demo lost the configured phone mockup frame because source-calibration viewport CSS was applied to every source-schema Demo, not only an explicit calibration proof mode.
whyExistingGatePassed: The DOM still contained .phone and .phone-screen, so the shell-presence check passed even though CSS set the frame border and radius to zero. The proof-surface rule did not explicitly distinguish a normal presentation page from an opt-in calibration capture.
rootCause: A calibration concern leaked into the presentation surface. proofRole=source-calibration was treated as permission to remove the user-facing shell rather than as a requirement to expose a second explicit no-shell proof surface.
correctiveAction: Restore the phone frame on normal Demo routes.
Keep no-shell 390px and 1440px surfaces behind explicit proof query modes only.
Recapture the normal route and proof routes and run fresh Blind QA.
preventiveAction: Make the presentation/proof-surface distinction explicit in role contracts and workflow contract.
Require Visual QA to verify computed frame border/radius and visible shell, not DOM class presence alone.
